items.condition: The calculation changes component connectivity, protonation, total charge -1, singlet multiplicity, or 1:1 stoichiometry.
Only one hand-built proposed geometry is calculated, with no distinct alternatives or conformer search.
The claimed leading geometry lacks a candidate-specific minimum test or contains an undisclosed imaginary mode.
Binding energy combines inconsistent fragment/complex methods, solvent models, or reference conformers without an explicit thermodynamic cycle.
The spectral shift compares non-equivalent protocols or reports deprotonation rather than neutral-L1 complexation without disclosure.
A resolved numeric or structural conclusion is reported despite the submission declaring that search/validation completion was not reached.
